items.example: Remote work reduces commuting time. Moreover, it allows companies to cut office costs.
items.warning: Úsalo para añadir un argumento MÁS fuerte o del mismo peso, no para cualquier detalle. No lo repitas en cada párrafo.

items.example: Public transport reduces congestion. Furthermore, it is accessible to people who cannot drive.

items.pattern: Sentence. In addition, clause. / In addition to + noun / -ing
items.example: In addition to lowering emissions, cycling improves public health.
items.warning: 'In addition to' va con sustantivo o -ing: ✗ 'In addition to lower emissions'.

items.example: The scheme is cheap. What is more, it can be introduced immediately.
I don't want to move to the city. Besides, the rents there are crazy.
items.warning: Es conversacional: bien en Speaking, evítalo en el essay. Y no confundir con 'beside' (= al lado de).

items.example: Online courses are also cheaper than traditional ones.
items.warning: Mejor en medio de la frase. 'Also,' al principio de frase suena informal en Writing.

items.example: The policy benefits the elderly as well as young families.

items.pattern: Not only + auxiliary + subject + verb, but + subject + also + verb
items.example: Not only does tourism create jobs, but it also helps preserve local traditions.
items.warning: Al inicio de frase exige inversión: ✗ 'Not only tourism creates jobs'.

items.example: Additionally, the government could offer tax incentives to small businesses.
items.warning: Correcto pero algo pesado; alterna con 'In addition' o 'Furthermore'.

items.pattern: Sentence. However, clause. / clause; however, clause.
items.example: Many people support the tax. However, few are willing to pay more themselves.
items.warning: No une dos frases con coma: ✗ 'It is cheap, however it is slow.' Usa punto o punto y coma.

items.pattern: Sentence. On the other hand, clause.
items.example: Living in the city is exciting. On the other hand, it can be very stressful.
items.warning: Puede usarse sin 'On the one hand', pero SIEMPRE debe introducir el otro lado de la misma cuestión, no un dato nuevo cualquiera. ✗ 'in the other hand'.

items.example: Older people tend to read newspapers, whereas younger people get their news online.

items.pattern: Sentence. By contrast, clause. / In contrast to + noun
items.example: Car use fell by 10%. By contrast, cycling doubled.
items.warning: Para comparar dos cosas distintas (A vs B), no para una concesión.

items.example: The plan is ambitious, but it is achievable.
items.warning: Evita empezar frases con 'But' en el essay; usa 'However'.

items.example: Higher taxes may reduce consumption. Conversely, lower taxes may encourage spending.
items.warning: Sólo para relaciones inversas (A→B / no A → no B); no es un sinónimo general de 'however'.

items.example: The project was expensive. Nevertheless, it proved extremely popular.
items.warning: Significa 'aun así': la segunda idea ocurre A PESAR de la primera.

items.pattern: Sentence. Instead, clause. / instead of + noun / -ing
items.example: Instead of building more roads, the city should invest in trams.
items.warning: ✗ 'instead of build': después de 'of' va -ing.

items.example: Unlike traditional exams, coursework rewards consistent effort.
items.warning: Va con sustantivo, no con frase: ✗ 'Unlike exams are stressful...'.

items.example: Many young people rent because house prices are too high.
Flights were cancelled because of the storm.
items.warning: ✗ 'because of the prices are high': 'because of' + sustantivo; 'because' + frase.

items.pattern: + noun phrase / be due to + noun
items.example: The rise in obesity is largely due to sedentary lifestyles.
items.warning: ✗ 'due to people eat badly'. Para frase completa: 'due to the fact that'.

items.example: Owing to a lack of funding, the museum closed in 2019.
As the population is ageing, healthcare costs will continue to rise.
items.warning: Indican una causa ya conocida; pon la frase de causa al principio.

items.example: As a result of automation, many factory jobs have disappeared.
Online shopping has grown rapidly. This is because it is convenient and often cheaper.
items.warning: Muy útil en TOEFL Academic Discussion para desarrollar razones. ✗ 'This is due to people prefer...'.

items.example: Given that most jobs now require digital skills, coding should be taught in schools.
The match was postponed on account of heavy rain.
items.warning: Bastante formal y poco frecuente; 'because of' o 'due to' son más seguros.

items.pattern: Sentence. Therefore, clause. / subject + therefore + verb
items.example: The population is ageing. Therefore, governments need to plan for higher pension costs.
items.warning: No une frases con coma: ✗ 'It is cheap, therefore it is popular.'

items.example: Fuel prices rose sharply. As a result, more people switched to public transport.
Many rural schools have closed. Consequently, children travel long distances to study.
Fewer cars enter the centre; air quality has thus improved significantly.
items.warning: Muy formales: dosifícalos. 'Hence' suele ir con sustantivo: 'hence the need for reform'.

items.example: Rents are high, so many graduates live with their parents.
items.warning: Bien en Speaking y TOEFL; en IELTS Task 2 alterna con 'therefore' / 'as a result'.

items.pattern: so + adj + that clause / such + (a) adj + noun + that clause
items.example: The city has become so expensive that teachers cannot afford to live there.
items.warning: ✗ 'such expensive that' / ✗ 'so expensive city that'.

items.pattern: cause + lead to / result in + noun / -ing
items.example: Poor diets can lead to serious health problems.
items.warning: ✗ 'lead to increase' (verbo): 'lead to an increase' o 'lead to people eating more'.

items.example: Children learn languages quickly. For this reason, schools should start teaching them early.
Many jobs are now online. This means that workers can live far from big cities.
items.warning: Muy natural para explicar consecuencias en Speaking y en el TOEFL Discussion.

items.example: Some countries have reduced plastic waste. For example, Kenya banned plastic bags in 2017.
items.warning: Tras 'For example,' va una frase completa, no sólo una lista: ✗ 'For example, Kenya.'

items.example: Renewable sources such as wind and solar power are becoming cheaper.
items.warning: Va con sustantivos, no con frases. ✗ 'such as the government should...'.

items.example: Several factors, including cost and safety, affect people's choice of transport.
Bring basic equipment (e.g. a torch and water).
items.warning: Abreviatura: evítala en el essay IELTS; escribe 'for example' o 'such as'.

items.example: Technology can widen inequality. To illustrate, rural students often lack fast internet.

items.phrase: A good example of this is
items.pattern: A good example of this is + noun
items.example: A good example of this is Copenhagen, where over 40% of commuters cycle.
items.warning: Muy útil en TOEFL Academic Discussion para aportar un ejemplo concreto.

items.pattern: In particular, clause. / particularly + noun / adj
items.example: Older people, in particular, benefit from free public transport.
Apps like Duolingo make language learning more accessible.
items.warning: Coloquial; en Writing formal prefiere 'such as'.

items.example: Two groups are most affected, namely the elderly and the unemployed.
items.warning: Sirve para especificar TODOS los elementos, no para dar un ejemplo entre muchos.

items.example: Firstly, public transport is cheaper than running a car.
items.warning: Evita el esquema mecánico 'Firstly... Secondly... Thirdly... Lastly' en todos los párrafos: los examinadores lo ven como enlace mecánico (limita Coherence & Cohesion).

items.example: Secondly, it reduces pollution in city centres.
The leaves are dried. Next, they are crushed and packed.
items.warning: Ideal para procesos (Task 1); en el essay suena a lista.

items.example: We visited the museum. Afterwards, we had lunch by the river.
items.warning: ✗ 'After, we had lunch': 'after' solo no funciona como conector.

items.example: The data were collected in 2020 and subsequently analysed by two researchers.
Car sales fell. Meanwhile, bicycle sales reached a record high.
Finally, the government should consider the long-term costs.
items.warning: 'Finally' = último punto de una lista. 'At last' = por fin (tras esperar): ✗ 'At last, I will conclude...'.

items.example: To begin with, the cost of living in big cities is extremely high.

items.pattern: Another reason is that + clause / A further point is + noun
items.example: Another reason is that cities offer better access to healthcare.
items.warning: Alternativa natural a 'Secondly' que mejora la cohesión.

items.pattern: The main reason (why...) is that + clause
items.example: The main reason why I prefer trains is that I can work during the journey.
items.warning: ✗ 'The main reason is because': mejor 'is that'.

items.example: In conclusion, while technology has disadvantages, its benefits for education are greater.
items.warning: Perfecto para el último párrafo de IELTS Task 2, pero NO lo uses en el TOEFL Email ni en el Academic Discussion (son textos breves, no essays).

items.example: To conclude, both individuals and governments must act on climate change.
To sum up, the advantages of remote work clearly outweigh the drawbacks.
Overall, the number of tourists increased, while average spending fell.
items.warning: Es LA palabra para abrir el overview de IELTS Task 1. ✗ 'In conclusion' en Task 1 (no hay opinión que concluir).

items.example: All in all, it was a great experience.
items.warning: Conversacional: bien en Speaking, demasiado informal para el essay.

items.example: In short, cities need better planning, not just more roads.
On balance, I believe the benefits of tourism outweigh its costs.
items.warning: Ideal para cerrar essays de discusión o ventajas/desventajas, porque indica que has sopesado ambos lados.

items.example: For these reasons, I think universities should be free.
items.warning: Buen cierre para el TOEFL Academic Discussion en lugar de 'In conclusion'.

items.example: Although electric cars are expensive, they are cheaper to run.
items.warning: ✗ 'Although..., but...': en inglés no se combinan 'although' y 'but'.

items.pattern: + noun phrase / -ing / the fact that + clause
items.example: Despite its high cost, the project was approved.
items.warning: ✗ 'Despite of' (incorrecto) ✗ 'Despite it is expensive'. Correcto: 'Despite being expensive' / 'Despite the fact that it is expensive' / 'In spite of'.

items.example: While some argue that zoos are cruel, others see them as vital for conservation.
items.warning: Excelente para abrir párrafos de essays de discusión. 'Whilst' es británico y más formal.

items.example: Admittedly, online learning can be isolating. However, it gives students more flexibility.
items.warning: Concede un punto del otro lado; suele ir seguido de 'However' para volver a tu argumento.

items.pattern: It is true that + clause. However, clause.
items.example: It is true that tourism can damage the environment. However, it also funds conservation.
The plan has some flaws. Even so, it is better than doing nothing.
Granted, the city is expensive, but the salaries are higher too.
items.warning: Bastante conversacional; en Writing formal usa 'Admittedly'.

items.example: Everyone should have access to healthcare, regardless of their income.
items.warning: ✗ 'Irregardless': no es estándar.

items.example: Air pollution is a serious problem. Indeed, it causes millions of deaths each year.
items.warning: Refuerza o amplía la idea anterior con algo más fuerte; no lo uses como simple relleno.

items.example: The scheme was not a failure. In fact, it exceeded its targets.
items.warning: Puede corregir una idea anterior o reforzarla. Recuerda: 'actually' = 'in fact', no 'actualmente'.

items.example: Clearly, more needs to be done to protect endangered species.
items.warning: 'Obviously' puede sonar arrogante en un essay; 'Clearly' es más seguro.

items.example: Above all, children need to feel safe at school.
items.warning: Sólo para el punto MÁS importante de una lista.

items.example: This is especially true in developing countries.
items.warning: ✗ 'Specially' en este sentido; y no al principio de frase: ✗ 'Especially, children...'.

items.pattern: It is worth noting that + clause
items.example: It is worth noting that most of this growth occurred after 2010.
Undoubtedly, the internet has transformed the way we work.
items.warning: Úsalo con moderación: afirmaciones demasiado absolutas debilitan el argumento académico.

items.example: Driving in the city is stressful, not to mention expensive.
items.warning: Muy natural en Speaking; algo coloquial para Task 2.

items.example: Significantly, the number of female engineers has doubled in a decade.
The city has a housing deficit. In other words, there are not enough homes for everyone.
items.warning: Úsalo para simplificar una idea compleja, no para repetir lo mismo con otras palabras sin aportar nada.

items.example: The policy targets low-income households, that is, those earning under £20,000.
items.warning: 'i.e.' = 'es decir' (≠ 'e.g.' = por ejemplo). Evita la abreviatura en el essay.

items.pattern: Sentence. To put it another way, clause.
items.example: Prices are rising faster than wages. To put it another way, people are getting poorer.
The report highlights one problem in particular. Specifically, schools lack trained teachers.
I'm not against tourism. What I mean is that it should be better managed.
items.warning: Excelente en Speaking para reformular sin bloquearte; demasiado oral para Writing.

items.example: Sales increased considerably. To be more precise, they rose by 37% in three years.
One factor stands out, namely the cost of housing.

items.phrase: In this sense / In this respect
items.example: Social media connects people. In this sense, it can reduce loneliness.
items.warning: ✗ 'In this sense' como calco de 'en este sentido' para cambiar de tema: sólo para matizar en qué aspecto es cierta la idea.

items.example: It's a nice town. I mean, there's not much to do, but people are friendly.
items.warning: Natural en Speaking si lo usas con moderación; abusar de él suena a muletilla.
